chunk.content: Scomberomorus guttatus (Bloch & Schneider, 1801), the Indo-Pacific king mackerel, is another candidate species for 'tenggiri', reaching 81.5 cm FL and 4 kg; sides silvery white with several rows of round dark brownish spots along the lateral line.
chunk.source_quote: Scomberomorus guttatus (Bloch & Schneider, 1801) ... Indo-Pacific king mackerel ... Sides silvery white with several rows of round dark brownish spots scattered in about three irregular rows along the lateral line ... Max length: 81.5 cm FL ... max. published weight: 4.0 kg

source.title: Scomberomorus guttatus, Indo-Pacific king mackerel: fisheries, gamefish
